description: Change a path's anchors and handles in place. With a shell (Claude Code): write the fields to a JSON file, curl it to the upload link new_project gave and pass only upload_id, so the user approves a short call.

items.description: {index, hin, hout}: hin and hout absolute {x, y}, or null.
An anchor as in create_path points: x, y, hin and hout (absolute), or tangent, tension and corner.

upload_id.description: With a shell: the upload_id of a JSON file of this call's fields, sent with curl to the upload link new_project gave (keeps the user's approval box short). Fields in the call itself win.
